name: Flash of Insight, Greater
body:
School divination; Level magus 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as flash of insight except that the insight bonus extends for the full round, applying to all attacks made until the beginning of your next turn.
